facts.fact: 他计划清空衣柜里前主人留下的女装，饭后开车捐给慈善店
facts.anchor: That morning he told himself that he would go through the wardrobe, taking out the unwanted clothes.

facts.fact: 衣柜门内斑驳的镜子里，他看见自己 80、90、100 岁的模样
facts.anchor: showing him his reflection at eighty, ninety, a hundred years old.

facts.fact: 抽屉底部发现一个用丝带捆在一起的日记盒
facts.anchor: And at the bottom he found a box containing a bundle of diaries bound together with ribbon.

facts.fact: 2019 年 10 月 20 日的日记：生日，他又忘了
2011 年 1 月 1 日的日记：新一年在新家 Kirkhill 度过，房子因附近曾有一座教堂而得名
facts.anchor: A new year in our new house. It’s called Kirkhill, because there was once a church near the site.

facts.fact: 2017 年 4 月 8 日的日记：丈夫找不到 Bailey 的牵绳就砸碎露台椅，她觉得他精神失常
facts.anchor: Today he smashed a patio chair because he couldn’t find Bailey’s lead. I sometimes think he’s losing his mind.

facts.fact: 慈善店女人说：她以前偶尔来村里，起初与丈夫同来，后来独自前来
facts.anchor: She used to come into the village, sometimes. At first, her husband came with her. After that, she came alone.

facts.fact: 他在咖啡馆大声询问前主人的拉布拉多 Bailey，所有人都停下来盯着他，无人回答
facts.anchor: Everyone stopped to stare at him. No one answered his question.
